data.title: The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Congratulates President of Lebanon on Independence Day
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud has sent a cable of congratulations to President of the Republic of Lebanon Joseph Aoun on his country’s Independence Day.
    The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques wished the president continued good health and happiness, and the government and people of Lebanon steady progress and prosperity.
    -- SPA
12:55 Local Time 09:55 GMT
